identity.name: AWS Credential & Secret Harvesting Behavioral Chain — CloudTrail (SIM-CDR-020)
identity.summary: One AWS IAM identity bulk-reads AWS Secrets Manager secrets and SSM Parameter Store parameters in a short window. XSIAM cloud-audit analytics flag it as two ABIOC alerts ('Suspicious secrets dump activity' and 'AWS SSM parameters retrieval'); a correlation stitches them into one credential-harvesting incident, driven by cloud_audit_emitter into cloud_audit_logs.
identity.description: Adversaries who obtain a foothold in AWS routinely mine the control plane's own secret stores rather than crack credentials: AWS Secrets Manager and SSM Parameter Store frequently hold database passwords, API keys and OAuth/application access tokens. A bulk read across many secrets or parameters by a single identity in a short window is a high-signal behavioral anomaly. The detections here are keyed on the cloud_audit_logs dataset (AWS CloudTrail control-plane events normalise to it) and expressed as ABIOC behavioral-ML rules anchored to the identity's learned baseline, plus a rule-based Analytics view over the combined harvesting chain and a validation query that confirms the emitted CloudTrail records landed.

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-CDR-020 — cloud_audit_emitter analytics streamer (AWS CloudTrail shape) posts shape-true records to an operator-supplied collector.

prerequisites.description: An operator-supplied HTTP collector already wired into Cortex XSIAM as the AWS CloudTrail (cloud_audit_logs) ingestion source, and the cortexsim EAL simulator with the cloud_audit_emitter plugin registered.

payload.code:
# cloud_audit_emitter posts shape-true AWS CloudTrail records to the
# operator-supplied collector so XSIAM cloud-audit analytics fire. No real
# AWS tenant is touched; every record uses RFC 5737 / .invalid canaries.
set -euo pipefail
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CDR-020 streaming SecretsManager + SSM retrieval to cloud_audit_logs'

input_variables.name: COLLECTOR_URL
input_variables.description: Operator-supplied HTTP collector wired into XSIAM as the AWS CloudTrail source.

expected_artifacts.description: Shape-true AWS CloudTrail records (secretsmanager.amazonaws.com GetSecretValue / BatchGetSecretValue, ssm.amazonaws.com GetParameter(s)/GetParametersByPath) landing in the cloud_audit_logs dataset, each carrying cortexsim_run_id.

abiocs.name: Suspicious secrets dump activity
abiocs.description: ABIOC — behavioral-ML anomaly: a single IAM identity reads an unusually high volume of AWS Secrets Manager secrets in a short window (a 'secrets dump'), well above the identity's learned baseline. Keyed on the cloud_audit_logs dataset (AWS CloudTrail control-plane events normalised to the XDM cloud-audit schema).
abiocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter event_source = "secretsmanager.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("GetSecretValue", "BatchGetSecretValue", "ListSecrets")
| filter isnull(error_code)
| comp count() as retrieval_calls by user_identity_arn, source_ip_address
| filter retrieval_calls >= 20
| fields user_identity_arn, source_ip_address, retrieval_calls
abiocs.causality_anchor: Anchored to the IAM identity's learned Secrets Manager access baseline (GetSecretValue call volume per identity per window); the ABIOC fires on the deviation, not a fixed threshold.

abiocs.name: AWS SSM parameters retrieval
abiocs.description: ABIOC — behavioral-ML anomaly: a single IAM identity retrieves an unusually high volume of SSM Parameter Store parameters (with_decryption=true, exposing tokens/keys held as SecureString) in a short window, above the identity's learned baseline. Keyed on the cloud_audit_logs dataset.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter event_source = "ssm.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("GetParameter", "GetParameters", "GetParametersByPath")
| filter with_decryption = true and isnull(error_code)
| comp count() as retrieval_calls by user_identity_arn, source_ip_address
| filter retrieval_calls >= 25
| fields user_identity_arn, source_ip_address, retrieval_calls
abiocs.causality_anchor: Anchored to the IAM identity's learned SSM Parameter Store access baseline (with_decryption GetParameters call volume per identity per window); the deviation drives the alert.

xql_queries.name: Cloud credential-store harvesting chain across SecretsManager and SSM
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter event_source in ("secretsmanager.amazonaws.com", "ssm.amazonaws.com")
| filter event_name in ("GetSecretValue", "BatchGetSecretValue", "GetParameter", "GetParameters", "GetParametersByPath")
| filter isnull(error_code)
| comp count() as credential_reads, count_distinct(event_source) as services_touched by user_identity_arn, source_ip_address
| filter credential_reads >= 30 and services_touched >= 2
| fields user_identity_arn, source_ip_address, credential_reads, services_touched

xql_queries.name: SIM-CDR-020 validation — SecretsManager and SSM reads landed
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter event_source in ("secretsmanager.amazonaws.com", "ssm.amazonaws.com")
| filter event_name in ("GetSecretValue", "BatchGetSecretValue", "ListSecrets", "GetParameter", "GetParameters", "GetParametersByPath")
| comp count() as observed_events by event_source, event_name
| sort desc observed_events
| fields event_source, event_name, observed_events

correlation_rules.name: SIM-CDR-020 — credential & secret harvesting behavioral chain
correlation_rules.logic: Fires when abioc `Suspicious secrets dump activity` and abioc `AWS SSM parameters retrieval` both observe the same user_identity_arn and source_ip_address within a 15-minute window, stitching the Secrets Manager dump and the SSM Parameter Store retrieval into one credential-harvesting incident (raises incident severity above either ABIOC alone).

use_cases.name: SIM-CDR-020 — AWS credential & secret harvesting behavioral chain
use_cases.description: Validate that Cortex XSIAM cloud-audit analytics flag a single identity bulk-reading Secrets Manager secrets and SSM parameters, and that a correlation stitches the two behaviors into one credential-harvesting incident.

test_cases.objective: The 'Suspicious secrets dump activity' ABIOC fires on a bulk Secrets Manager read burst by one identity.
preconditions: Collector wired into XSIAM as the AWS CloudTrail (cloud_audit_logs) source.
cloud_audit_emitter plugin registered in the cortexsim EAL simulator.
steps: Stream a SecretsManager GetSecretValue / BatchGetSecretValue burst across many secrets via cloud_audit_emitter.
Observe the 'Suspicious secrets dump activity' ABIOC fire.
success_criteria: The ABIOC raises on the seeded identity within the run window.

test_cases.objective: The 'AWS SSM parameters retrieval' ABIOC fires on a bulk SSM parameter retrieval burst by the same identity.
preconditions: Collector wired into XSIAM as the AWS CloudTrail (cloud_audit_logs) source.
steps: Stream an SSM GetParameter(s)/GetParametersByPath (WithDecryption) burst across many parameters via cloud_audit_emitter.
Observe the 'AWS SSM parameters retrieval' ABIOC fire.
success_criteria: The ABIOC raises on the seeded identity within the run window.

test_cases.objective: Correlation CR-CDR-0020 stitches both behaviors into one incident and the validation query confirms the CloudTrail records landed.
preconditions: Both ABIOCs fired for the same identity within the correlation window.
steps: Run the SIM-CDR-020 validation XQL to confirm the emitted SecretsManager + SSM records are present in cloud_audit_logs.
Observe correlation CR-CDR-0020 raise a single credential-harvesting incident.
success_criteria: Correlation `CR-CDR-0020` raises one incident and the validation query returns >= 1 row.

preventive_controls: Scope IAM policies so no single role can read the entire Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store; prefer per-secret resource policies and least-privilege GetSecretValue / GetParameter grants.
Require WithDecryption reads of SecureString parameters to be gated by dedicated roles and short-lived session credentials.
Enable Secrets Manager rotation and CloudTrail data events for Secrets Manager / SSM so retrievals are auditable.
detection_engineering: Baseline per-identity distinct-secret and distinct-parameter access counts; alert on deviation rather than a fixed threshold (the ABIOC anchors to the learned baseline).
Correlate Secrets Manager dumps with SSM parameter retrievals from the same identity/source IP to raise incident severity above either alone.
Confirm CloudTrail control-plane events for secretsmanager.amazonaws.com and ssm.amazonaws.com are ingested into the cloud_audit_logs dataset before relying on these detections.
